title: Boston Counsel Roundtable — venue, NDAs & final itinerary
text:
Boston Counsel Roundtable — venue, NDAs & final itinerary

["From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>\\nTo: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>\\nDate: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 13:12:00 -0400\\nSubject: Exec Roundtable — Boston (Oct 19) — venue & NDA needs\\n\\nTeam —\\n\\nQuick note to kick off planning for the Boston counsel roundtable on Oct 19 (evening). Goal: intimate dinner for ~18 senior legal/compliance folks across 6 target accounts (Maple Health, Skybound, Meridian Care, two others). Key asks:\\n- Confirm recommended venue (private dining) and contract timeline\\n- Decide whether we require guest NDAs signed before attendance (CS & legal have a preference for pre-sign)\\n- Finalize invite list + any procurement contacts who need PO/invoice prior to event\\n\\nAttached is a first-pass guest list (guest_list_v1.csv). Laura — can you own outreach cadence? Monica — can you loop legal on NDA language? Aditya — budget check and whether we can cover travel stipends for any panelists. I'll coordinate venue options and contracts.\\n\\nThanks,\\nMarcus\\nMarcus Lin\\nEnterprise Sales, Redwood Inference\\n\\n[attachment: guest_list_v1.csv (csv)]", "From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>\\nTo: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>\\nDate: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0400\\nSubject: Re: Exec Roundtable — Boston (Oct 19) — venue & NDA needs\\n\\nMarcus —\\n\\nThanks. Quick updates:\\n- I cleaned the guest list and added titles + dietary flags (see attached). Asha Rao (Skybound) and Tom Walters (Maple Health) are our primary confirmations so far.\\n- Procurement for Maple Health will likely want an invoice/PO; cc'd procurement@maplehealth.io in later outbound.\\n- RSVP deadline: Oct 8 to give venue final headcount.\\n\\nI can start personal outreach next week. If we require NDAs, can we get an editable doc today so I can send a single packet to all invitees?\\n\\nLaura\\nLaura Bennett\\nField Marketing — Events, Redwood Inference\\n\\n[attachment: guest_list_v2.csv (csv)]", "From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>\\nTo: Caroline Ellis <caroline@elmhouseboston.com>\\nCc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>\\nDate: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0400\\nSubject: Elm House — availability + requirements for Oct 19 roundtable\\n\\nHi Caroline —\\n\\nWe run a handful of small executive dinners in Boston and Elm House came recommended. Are you available on the evening of Oct 19 for a private dinner (6-9pm) for ~18 guests with a short 20 minute program? We have two specific requirements: a private room with a head table and AV for a mic/lectern, and the ability to lock the guest list (no walk-ins).\\n\\nAttached is an outline of logistical requirements. Can you confirm availability and share a sample contract or standard terms we can review (we prefer to review before sending to our legal)? Also note some guests may need to sign a short NDA in advance — is it typical for Elm House to accept a third-party NDA or would you prefer we use Elm House's venue agreement?\\n\\nThanks — Marcus\\n\\n[attachment: requirements_for_venue.pdf (pdf)]", 'From: Caroline Ellis <caroline@elmhouseboston.com>\\nTo: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>\\nCc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>\\nDate: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0400\\nSubject: Re: Elm House — availability + requirements for Oct 19 roundtable\\n\\nHi Marcus —\\n\\nElm House is available Oct 19 and we can accommodate a private dinner for 18 in our Maple Room. We can provide a mic/lectern and a locked guest list for the evening. I attached a draft of our standard event agreement and a line-item quote — please note the bar minimum and a small room fee.\\n\\nRegarding NDAs: we are happy to accept a third-party NDA for guests. Our legal team asks for the agreement to be shared 10 days before the event to review any venue-specific clauses.\\n\\nDocuSign link for the venue agreement (sample): https://www.docusign.com/embedded/signing?token=elmhouse-quote-987654\\n\\nHappy to talk through numbers if helpful.\\n\\nBest,\\nCaroline Ellis\\nEvents Manager, Elm House Boston\\n\\n[attachment: elmhouse_contract_draft.pdf (pdf)]', 'From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>\\nTo: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>\\nDate: Fri, 24 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0400\\nSubject: Re: Exec Roundtable — Boston (Oct 19) — NDA language + logistics\\n\\nMarcus/Laura —\\n\\nAttached is an editable NDA (NDA_ExecRoundtable.docx) that covers typical event-level confidentiality for executive gatherings. I propose:\\n- Require guest signature before the event (deadline Oct 10)\\n- Send a single packet (invite + NDA + one-pager agenda) via DocuSign; we handle signatures and record retention\\n- For vendors/venue: Elm House can sign venue addendum but we should avoid adding venue-specific indemnities into guest NDAs.\\n\\nIf you want, I can prepare the DocuSign envelope and share a link to include in the invite. Budgetary note: DocuSign charges will be under the events budget.\\n\\nMonica Patel\\nLegal Counsel, Redwood Inference\\n\\n[attachment: NDA_ExecRoundtable.docx (docx)]', "From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>\\nTo: Asha Rao <asha.rao@skybound.com>, Tom Walters <tom.walters@maplehealth.io>, procurement@maplehealth.io\\nCc: Caroline Ellis <caroline@elmhouseboston.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>\\nDate: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0400\\nSubject: Invitation — Boston Counsel Roundtable (Oct 19) — RSVP & NDA link\\n\\nAsha/Tom —\\n\\nIt was great speaking briefly at RSA last month. We'd like to invite you to a small counsel roundtable dinner Redwood is hosting in Boston on Oct 19, 6–9pm at Elm House (private room). The format will be a 20-minute welcome + short discussion; dinner and networking afterwards. Space is limited to keep the conversation candid.\\n\\nAction items / links:\\n- Please complete this RSVP form by Oct 8: https://forms.gle/roundtable-boston-2026\\n- Please sign the guest NDA by Oct 10 (DocuSign): https://www.docusign.com/embedded/signing?token=abc123def456\\n- The venue will provide a fixed menu; let us know dietary restrictions on the RSVP form.\\n\\nAttached: current guest list (guest_list_v3.csv) for your reference. If procurement requires an invoice/PO, I cc'd procurement@maplehealth.io — let me know and I can route our billing contact.\\n\\nWe'd love to have you join. Please reply direct if you have questions.\\n\\nBest,\\nMarcus Lin\\nEnterprise Sales, Redwood Inference\\n\\n[attachment: guest_list_v3.csv (csv)]"]
